title_jp: {将来|しょうらい}の{仕事|しごと}
context: Tuesday 15 December: after 4th-period English on 'future jobs', {佐藤先生|さとうせんせい} asks {澪|みお} what she wants to be. {澪|みお} says an interpreter but worries about pay, and asks アルちゃん what his work is like.
scene: Tuesday, after English class. Today's theme was future jobs. {澪|みお} has a dream, a worry about money, and a question for you.

phrases.jp: どんなお{仕事|しごと}をされているんですか。
phrases.en: What kind of work do you do?
phrases.note: されている = respectful している. The safe way to ask an adult you've just met.

phrases.jp: {時給|じきゅう|hourly wage|3}はいくらですか。
phrases.note: Part-time jobs are paid by the hour. Ask it at an interview, not to friends' parents.

phrases.jp: お{金|かね}より、{やりがい||sense of purpose, being worth doing|3}が{大事|だいじ}だと{思います|おもいます}。
phrases.en: I think a sense of purpose matters more than money.
phrases.note: やりがい: the feeling that a job is worth doing.

phrases.jp: {冬|ふゆ}のボーナスなら、もう{出ました|でました}よ。
phrases.en: If you mean the winter bonus, it's already been paid.
phrases.note: Many Japanese workers get a bonus in early December, a big topic in the staff room.

phrases.jp: {安定|あんてい|stability|3}した{仕事|しごと}がいいな。
phrases.note: {安定|あんてい}した + noun = stable. A very common wish among students.

dialogue_setting: Classroom 2-3 after 4th period. '{将来|しょうらい}の{職業|しょくぎょう}' is still on the blackboard. Snow outside.

dialogue.speaker: 佐藤先生
dialogue.jp: {今日|きょう}のテーマは「{将来|しょうらい}の{仕事|しごと}」でしたね。{澪|みお}さんは{何|なに}になりたいんですか。
dialogue.en: Today's theme was 'future jobs'. What do you want to be, {澪|みお}さん?

dialogue.speaker: 澪
dialogue.jp: {通訳|つうやく|interpreter, interpreting|3}です。{人|ひと}と{人|ひと}を{言葉|ことば}で{つなぐ|つなぐ|to connect|3}{仕事|しごと}って、かっこよくないですか。
dialogue.en: An interpreter. A job that connects people through language, isn't that cool?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {通訳|つうやく|interpreter|3}なら、{澪|みお}さんに{ぴったり||perfect, just right|4}だよ。{面接|めんせつ}の{英語|えいご}も{上手|じょうず}だったし。
dialogue.en: If it's interpreting, that's perfect for you. Your English at the interview was great too.

dialogue.speaker: 澪
dialogue.jp: でも{給料|きゅうりょう}とか、{安定|あんてい|stability|3}してるのかな…。アルちゃんの{仕事|しごと}って、どんな{感じ|かんじ}？
dialogue.en: But is the pay and stuff stable, I wonder… What's your work like, アルちゃん?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {朝|あさ}は{畑|はたけ|field, orchard|3}、{午後|ごご}はゲストハウスの{受付|うけつけ}。{給料|きゅうりょう}はないけど、{毎日|まいにち}{勉強|べんきょう}になるよ。
dialogue.en: Mornings in the orchard, afternoons on guesthouse reception. There's no pay, but I learn something every day.

dialogue.speaker: 佐藤先生
dialogue.jp: {仕事|しごと}を{選ぶ|えらぶ|to choose|4}なら、{好き|すき}なことと{得意|とくい|good at, strong point|4}なことを、{両方|りょうほう|both|4}{考える|かんがえる}といいですよ。
dialogue.en: If you're choosing a job, it's good to think about both what you love and what you're good at.

listening.intro: At lunch break, {恵子|けいこ}さん leaves you a voicemail.

lines.jp: アルちゃん、{恵子|けいこ}です。{今日|きょう}は{雪|ゆき}がひどいから、{車|くるま}で{迎えに|むかえに}{行く|いく}わね。
lines.en: アルちゃん, it's {恵子|けいこ}. The snow's bad today, so I'll come and pick you up by car.

lines.jp: {学校|がっこう}の{前|まえ}に4{時半|じはん}でいいかしら。{無理|むり}なら{連絡|れんらく}してね。
lines.en: Is 4:30 in front of the school OK? If it's not possible, let me know.

listening.question: {恵子|けいこ}さんは、いつどこに{来ますか|きますか}。
listening.explain: {学校|がっこう}の{前|まえ}に4{時半|じはん}: in front of the school at 4:30.

grammar.meaning: if it's the case that / as for
grammar.form: noun: + なら ({通訳|つうやく}なら, ボーナスなら) · verb: plain form + なら ({選|えら}ぶなら, {行|い}くなら) · adjective: + なら ({寒|さむ}いなら, {無理|むり}なら)
grammar.explanation: なら picks up a topic or plan someone just mentioned: 'if it's X, then…'. It's perfect for advice. Unlike たら, the advice can come before the action: {長野|ながの}に{行|い}くなら = before you go. No だ before なら.

examples.jp: {長野|ながの}に{行く|いく}なら、そばを{食べて|たべて}ね。
examples.en: If you're going to Nagano, have some soba.

examples.jp: {寒い|さむい}なら、こたつに{入りなよ|はいりなよ}。
examples.en: If you're cold, get under the kotatsu.

quiz.question: A: {明日|あした}、{白馬|はくば}に{行く|いく}んだ。 B: {白馬|はくば}に{行く|いく}＿＿、{手袋|てぶくろ|gloves|3}を{忘れないで|わすれないで}ね。
quiz.en: A: I'm going to Hakuba tomorrow. B: If you're going to Hakuba, don't forget your gloves.
quiz.explain: Advice before the trip → なら. {行|い}ったら would mean 'once you're there'.

quiz_more.question: コーヒー＿＿、{駅前|えきまえ}の{喫茶店|きっさてん|coffee shop|3}がおいしいよ。
quiz_more.en: If it's coffee you want, the café by the station is good.
quiz_more.explain: Noun + なら picks up the topic: 'as for coffee'.

quiz_more.question: {無理|むり|impossible, too much|4}＿＿、{言って|いって}ね。
quiz_more.en: If it's too much, tell me.
quiz_more.explain: な-adjectives and nouns take なら directly, never だなら.

kanji.where: On the blackboard: {将来|しょうらい}の{職業|しょくぎょう}.
kanji.breakdown: {職|しょく} post, duty + {業|ぎょう} work, business → the work you do as your post: occupation.
kanji.related: Forms ask: ご{職業|しょくぎょう} = Occupation. {就職|しゅうしょく} = getting a job.

tip.title: {将来|しょうらい}の{夢|ゆめ} and {就活|しゅうかつ}
tip.body: Japanese kids are asked about their {将来|しょうらい}の{夢|ゆめ} (future dream) all through school. At university, job-hunting ({就活|しゅうかつ}) starts in the third year, with everyone in the same black {リクルートスーツ||job-hunting suit|2}. Many people still join one company straight after graduating.

challenge.prompt: {澪|みお}: 「アルちゃんは、{将来|しょうらい}どんな{仕事|しごと}がしたい？」 Answer casually: if you can choose, you'd like a job that uses Japanese.
challenge.model_answer: {選べる|えらべる}なら、{日本語|にほんご}を{使う|つかう}{仕事|しごと}がしたいな。
challenge.explanation: {選|えら}べる is 'can choose', and なら makes it 'if I can choose'. {日本語|にほんご}を{使|つか}う{仕事|しごと} describes the job with a verb before the noun. たいな is a soft, casual wish, right for {澪|みお}.

vocab.note: Spoken. Written translation is {翻訳|ほんやく}.
{手|て}をつなぐ = hold hands. Wi-Fiにつなぐ = connect to Wi-Fi.
〜にぴったり = perfect for. Also for clothes that fit exactly.
{安定|あんてい}する = to be stable. {安定|あんてい}した{仕事|しごと} = a steady job.
火 fire + 田 field: fields once cleared by burning. Rice paddy: {田|た}んぼ.
Choosing from several. Can choose: {選|えら}べる.
〜が{得意|とくい}. Opposite: {苦手|にがて}. Modest people rarely say it about themselves.
{時|じ} hour + {給|きゅう} pay. On job posters: {時給|じきゅう}1,100{円|えん}〜.

kanji_study.parts: 言 words radical + 尺 a measure → measuring words from one language against another: translate. Also the 'reason' behind things.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 駅 (station): 駅 has 馬 a horse on the left, 訳 has 言 words.

kanji_study.parts: 辶 road radical + 巽 two people kneeling on a stand → walking along a line of candidates and picking one: choose.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 遅 (late): both have 辶, but 選 has two 己 shapes on top.
